prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production-oriented pixel art walking sprite-sheet PROPOSAL for the first configurable character in a top-down 2D social arcade game.
Image 1 is only the selected visual-family reference, not an edit target. Base this first character closely on the cyan-hoodie human in that family, but REMOVE the baseball cap so head accessories can be added separately later.
Create ONE single PNG image with genuinely TRANSPARENT background, showing exactly ONE consistent original human character in TWELVE full-body walking poses. Arrange the twelve figures in a perfectly regular grid: EXACTLY 3 columns by 4 rows, every cell identical dimensions, same character scale and foot baseline, generous equal transparent padding, no characters crossing cell boundaries.
Row 1: faces DOWN toward viewer, columns = standing neutral, left-foot step, right-foot step.
Row 2: faces LEFT, columns = standing neutral, left-foot step, right-foot step.
Row 3: faces RIGHT, columns = standing neutral, left-foot step, right-foot step.
Row 4: faces UP away from viewer, columns = standing neutral, left-foot step, right-foot step.
Consistent top-down classic handheld-RPG perspective, see a little top of the head, NOT isometric. The face MUST NOT be visible in the back-view bottom row. Left/right views have a proper side-view face and a single visible eye. The last two columns must visibly alternate feet and arms, small changes with 1-logical-pixel vertical body bob, NOT twelve copies of idle.
Character: cute compact slightly-human chibi, oversized tousled dark-brown hair merging into squat torso, no long neck, warm medium skin tone, tiny simple black eyes, bright CYAN hoodie with a tiny lighter-cyan hood/drawstring detail, deep navy charcoal pants, short white sneakers with cyan soles. No hat, no cap, no glasses, no backpack, no handheld object. Round/blocky expressive silhouette, very simple limbs and small hands, exactly the same outfit/hair/skin in every pose.
Medium: authentic LOW-resolution pixel sprite. Draw each pose as if it fits a 48x48 logical pixel cell, character roughly 28 pixels wide and 38 pixels tall, then uniformly enlarge nearest-neighbor. Crisp hard square pixels, dark navy 1-logical-pixel outline, 2 or 3 tones per material, solid flat color clusters, no anti-aliasing, no gradients, no soft highlights, no glow, no painted texture, no smooth vector contours. Preserve the arcade family from the reference but simplify enough for a true readable small game sprite. Fixed orthographic camera and body proportions in all cells.
No lettering, labels, arrows, grid lines, logo, watermark, captions, palette swatches, extra overview figure, extra columns or rows. No floor, no stage, no scenery, NO grey checkerboard painted into the image. Real alpha transparency. This is a first-character pose-sheet proposal, not a character lineup.
status: Generated pose-sheet proposal; not yet aligned, composited or integrated as a production sprite atlas.
